summary: Pluri Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) updating discussions with the European Investment Bank (EIB) regarding a €50 million finance agreement. Only the first €20 million tranche (disbursed June 2021, 4% interest) was drawn; maturity was June 1, 2026. The EIB has reserved rights but indicated constructive discussions are ongoing, subject to internal approval and legal review, with no enforcement action currently contemplated. No definitive resolution has been reached. This filing is an ordinary update on debt negotiations, not a special situation.
